You build the system.
We build its test aircraft.

Before new equipment goes into service, it needs to prove itself beyond the laboratory.

Veylan builds Sable, a reusable uncrewed aircraft for your test programme, with equipment integration support and test preparation. Fit your hardware, evaluate it in flight, then recover it for inspection and another test.

For sensor manufacturers, aerospace development teams and research organisations moving equipment beyond the lab.

Inside the platform

What Veylan
provides.

Sable is the aircraft. Integration support and test preparation help your team build a programme around it.

Sable test aircraft+

A reusable uncrewed aircraft for your development programme. Discuss the equipment you want to carry and the tests you need to run, then agree the aircraft configuration around those requirements.

Equipment integration+

Work with Veylan on equipment mounting, power connections and the recording setup. The installation and compatibility requirements are agreed before preparing the aircraft for testing.

Test preparation+

Prepare the ground checks, inspection access and configuration records with Veylan. Your team runs the flights; Veylan helps prepare the aircraft and equipment installation.

The aircraft returns.
So does your equipment.

Open the bay. Inspect the hardware. Compare what you recorded with what you found. Then prepare the next flight with a clearer understanding of your system.
